channel.description: Latest articles from The Bakersfield Californian (bakersfield.com)

item.title: BPD looking for man who stole cigarettes at convenience store
item.description: The Bakersfield Police Department is requesting the public’s help in identifying a man who it says threatened employees and stole cigarettes Feb. 7 at the Ampm store at 3125 California Ave.

item.title: Neither Democratic candidate secures party endorsement in 22nd District race
item.description: Neither Democratic candidate for the 22nd Congressional District secured an endorsement at the party’s convention in San Francisco over the weekend.

item.title: Showers resume at Lerdo jail but drinking water advisory continues
item.description: Inmates at Lerdo jail are welcome to shower again now that the Kern County Sheriff’s Office says it has installed water filters to block diesel fuel contamination at the facility.

item.title: Supper and Snacks in the Stacks program feeding thousands of meals to kids
item.description: MORE INFORMATION The Kern County Library’s Supper and Snacks in the Stacks program is available at these 14 branches: Beale Memorial Library, Monday-Friday Frazier Park Branch Library, Tuesday-Friday Holloway-Gonzales Branch, Tuesday-Friday Lamont Branch Library, Tuesday-Friday McFarland Branch Library, Tuesday-Friday Northeast…

item.title: Large industrial park proposed on east side of Highway 99 north of 7th Standard Road
item.description: A distribution hub being proposed on the east side of Highway 99 north of Bakersfield would press 739 acres of table grape vineyards into service extending Kern County’s industrial real estate momentum.

item.title: PHOTO GALLERY: Beauty on Bena
item.description: Recent storms produced a vision of late-winter beauty on Friday along Bena Road east of Edison. Snow on local mountains served as an almost surreal backdrop as a freight train traveled west on the Union Pacific Railroad past emerald-green foothills.…

item.title: Local group wants to run red in blue California
item.description: Frustration and optimism mixed Monday night at a conservative forum where candidates from around the state urged their fellow citizens to help them push back against California’s Democratic supermajority.

item.title: BCHS girls basketball reaches D-2 final despite setback; Championship week is here for locals
item.description: The Bakersfield Christian High girls basketball team is gearing up for its third CIF Central Section championship game this Friday, a 6 p.m. Division II title meeting with Hanford’s Sierra Pacific at Selland Arena.

item.title: Frontier boys, Highland girls among 58 local wrestlers to qualify for State
item.description: The ultimate destination for all CIF boys and girls wrestlers is to compete in the state championship tournament.

item.title: Condors fall in OT, play key road series this week; CSUB hoops swept by Fullerton; 'Runners, Renegade recaps
item.description: The Calgary Wranglers scored a goal with just over a minute left in regulation and then needed 31 seconds into overtime to defeat the Bakersfield Condors 5-4 Friday at Dignity Health Arena.
